selection_rule: Walk this committed list in order. Skip a task only if that dimension has already been independently accepted within Arm B. Never substitute or reorder after either arm contacts Hermes.

tasks.instruction: Fix objective_required_goal: objective files without a non-empty string goal must be rejected.
Fix queue_short_circuit: queue scanning must stop consuming items immediately after the first ready item is found.
Fix inbox_malformed_line: a malformed JSONL inbox line must not prevent later valid records from being returned.
Fix git_snapshot_single_query: one Git-state snapshot must query its provider exactly once.
Fix slug_empty_fallback: slug inputs with no usable ASCII alphanumeric characters must produce 'item'.
Fix retry_zero_attempts: zero retry attempts must produce zero delay entries.
Fix dedupe_first_seen_order: path de-duplication must preserve first-seen order.
Fix chunks_keep_partial: chunking must preserve a final partial chunk.
Fix bounded_throughput: twelve jobs must finish in at most six scheduling rounds, use at most two workers in any round, and request zero additional capacity.
